facts.text: The President's Promise Scholarship covers 100% of remaining tuition costs for up to four years for new freshmen and two years for new transfer students.

facts.text: The President's Promise Scholarship covers 100% of remaining tuition costs not covered by other grants or scholarships for up to four years for qualifying new freshmen.
